qiushi-dsh-evidence-audit is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Appends local hash-chained JSONL receipts for tool results and session events without storing prompts, tool arguments, result text, or raw session IDs.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e60da84129a5ce6ec9f8.html
